drivingQuestion: What is the em whose removal the mishna says leaves the animal kosher?
outcomeNote: A lexical identification of the mishna's term, with no dispute.

segments.he: נִיטְּלָה הָאֵם שֶׁלָּהּ, תָּנָא: הִיא הָאֵם, הִיא טַרְפַּחַת, וְהִיא שַׁלְפּוּחִית.
segments.en: § The mishna states: If «its womb [em] was removed,» the animal remains kosher. A Sage «taught: The em is» synonymous with the «tarpaḥat, and it is» synonymous with the «shalpuḥit.»

moves.summary: quotes the mishna's ruling on a removed womb

moves.about: bringing a tannaitic statement identifying the three names of the organ the mishna calls em
